Justification for Other than Full and Open Competition Guidance Local Control Number NGB Control Number (if applicable) 1a. CONTRACTING ACTIVITY b. Requiring Activity c. POC 180th Fighter Wing, Swanton, Ohio F9F3CE - Civil Engineering Squadron ███ ███████████████ 2a. NATURE OF ACTION b. Contract Action c. Contract Type d. Fund Type Limited Sources; Individual Basis New Contract Firm Fixed Price O&M, Air 3a. ESTIMATED PRICE $███████ 4a. Name of Requirement Emergency Hangar HVAC Coil Repair b. Description of Requirement #1. Repair two (2) coils RTU West #2. Install new heat trace on the supply and return lines from the building loop up to the unit itself. #3. Run calculations on heat transfer of raw water to glycol and demonstrate coils/hardware support the loss. #4. In the mechanical room - cut off water feed from domestic and install and fill system with 70/30 blend of glycol; 50 Gallon make up tank for feeder and by pass system to manually feed. c. Demonstrate, in Detail, Why This Specific Item or Service, is the Only One That Meets Your Requirements On or around the 20th of January 2026, building 101 had a roof HVAC unit go down due to a frozen pipe bursting. Maintenance personnel located on sight rapidly isolated the issue; cleaning up the leak that was dumping water into the administrative offices located in the building. Also, they worked to equalize the heating system so that the building temps remained relatively stable. The 180th Contracting office was contacted by base leadership and Civil Engineering to urgently help facilitate a long-term solution.

Civil Engineering, in hoping a repair could be made via GPC, allowed █████ █████████ ██████ to provide a service call and assess the situation. Due to ongoing inclement weather and severely low temperatures expected over the following weeks, the parties involved believe it is imperative to move on to a solution, quickly. This would be in the best interest of the Government to prevent further and potentially future damage to the facilities.

There are multiple vendors that can complete this work; however, due to the severity of the situation, expediting the repairs via Sole Source using FAR 6.302-2 Unusual and compelling urgency, is believed to be the responsible solution and in the Governments best interest. The delay associated with competitive solicitation may expose the government to unacceptable risk of further damage to Building 101. ██████ is verified in SAM and was able to quickly respond and can fulfill the needs of the requirement.

5a. HAS THIS BEEN PREVIOUSLY PROCURED? Yes, details are below. ✔ No.

6a. AUTHORITY CITED 10 U.S.C. 2304(a)(2) or 41 U.S.C. 3304(a)(2) as implemented in FAR 6.302-2 Unusual and compelling urgency. b. Reason for Authority Cited Due to ongoing inclement weather and severely low temperatures expected over the following weeks, the parties involved believe it is imperative to move on to a solution, quickly. This would be in the best interest of the Government to prevent further and potentially future damage to the facilities.

7. POSTING REQUIREMENTS None.

8. CONTRACTING REQUIREMENTS a. Efforts to Obtain Competition The proposed action is made under unusual and compelling urgency (see FAR 6.302-2) and the Government would be seriously injured (as described above) if the agency sought competition. As such, no additional efforts were made to obtain competition.

SEPTEMBER 23, 2025 CUI//SP-SSEL 2 of 3

CUI//SP-SSEL b. Actions to Increase Competition Due to the unusual and compelling urgency of the requirement, no action was taken to increase competition. The Government will endeavor to conduct ongoing market research to develop a pool of qualified vendors should something like this occur again, so that quotes/competition may be obtained under the Simplified Acquisition Procedures to the maximum extent practicable. c. Market Research In hoping it could be a repair made with GPC, ████ ████ ████ did a service call and provided an estimate for the full coil replacement. There are multiple vendors that can complete this work, however we are going to expedite the repair and go Sole Source using FAR 6.302-2 Unusual and compelling urgency to avoid losing heat in the building and additional damage taking place. d. Interested Sources There are multiple vendors that can complete this work, however we are going to expedite the repair and go Sole Source using FAR 6302-2 Unusual and compelling urgency. e.
